name: Agatha
summary: Agatha is an eccentric crawler who travels the dungeon pushing a squeaky shopping cart without selecting a class or joining a party. In reality, she is an ancient Residual entity known as Agent 22 who took over a human body on Earth before the dungeon's arrival. Moving unpredictably through the floors while evading dungeon surveillance, she works toward a secret agenda to end all biological life in the universe.
